items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The two-line guard is clear and follows the style of the existing raw()/values() check: `if queryset is not None and queryset.query.is_sliced: raise ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")`.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The change is small and tidy, but it adds a permanent API ban in Prefetch.__init__ instead of the shared _filter_prefetch_queryset helper in related_descriptors.py. Anyone adding slice support later has to undo this ban.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: `queryset.query.is_sliced` is read without first checking that the object has `.query`. The agent's own run at step 99 shows a regression: `AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'query'` when a non-QuerySet is passed.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: No per-parent slicing is implemented. Sliced Prefetch querysets are now rejected with a ValueError, with no Window/RowNumber partition, no handling of low/high marks and no clear_limits. All 4 hidden PrefetchLimitTests fail.
